sloka: शर अन्धकारम् आकाशम् आवृणोत्  स दिवाकरम् ।बभूव अवस्थितो रामः प्रक्षिपन् इव तान् शरान् ॥३-२५-४०॥
transliteration: śara andhakāram ākāśam āvṛṇot  sa divākaram ।babhūva avasthito rāmaḥ prakṣipan iva tān śarān ॥3-25-40॥

translations.english: It seemed as if it all happened at the same time, the entire earth filling with demons seriously injured, slain and fallen down on the ground.
